description: Poll a triageEvalRuns run by id — for a large corpus (more than 10 cases) anyforge_run_triage_eval returns a QUEUED run immediately rather than waiting for it to finish; call this to check progress and read the completed result once status is completed or halted_payment_required. Safe to call repeatedly.
name: anyforge_get_triage_eval_run
title: Get triage eval run
